user.title: Set up departure board
user.description: Select source sensors in priority order. New sources must have a departures list. The first source wins duplicate conflicts.

details.title: Stops and delay units
details.description: For each sensor: group: field = stop group (empty = separate stop); unit: field = source delay unit. Use identical groups only for the same stop.

error.invalid_source: Select at least one sensor with a departures list. The dashboard itself cannot be a source.

abort.already_configured: The board is already configured. Use its options to make changes.
